groups.conditions: Diabetes, kidney disease, established CVD and atrial fibrillation
groups.acute: Acute chest pain and coronary syndromes

models.name: SCORE2
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 40-69, four ESC risk regions
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd and the published worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2

score2(age=[50, 62], sex=["male", "female"], smoker=[1, 0], sbp=[140, 130],
       total_chol=[5.5, 6.1], hdl_chol=[1.3, 1.6], diabetes=0, region="low")

models.name: SCORE2-OP
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 70-89, adjusted for competing risk
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd and the published worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_op

score2_op(age=75, sex="female", smoker=0, sbp=150, total_chol=5.8,
          hdl_chol=1.5, diabetes=0, region="moderate")

models.name: SCORE2-Diabetes
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk in type 2 diabetes, ages 40-69
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd and the published worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_diabetes

score2_diabetes(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.2,
                diabetes=1, age_at_diabetes_diagnosis=52, hba1c=58, egfr=80, region="moderate")

models.name: SCORE2-CKD
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with eGFR (and optionally albuminuria) add-ons
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd and the published worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_ckd

score2_ckd(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.3,
           diabetes=0, egfr=45, region="moderate", acr=30, addon="acr")

models.name: SCORE2 Asia-Pacific
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, ages 40-69, four Asia-Pacific risk regions
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd and the published worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score2_asia_pacific

score2_asia_pacific(age=55, sex="male", smoker=1, sbp=140, total_chol=5.5,
                    hdl_chol=1.2, diabetes=0, region="high")

models.name: SCORE
models.outcome: 10-year fatal CVD, total-cholesterol model, high- and low-risk regions
models.verification: Verified against all 800 cells of the official charts (798 within printed precision; 2 chart anomalies documented).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import score

score(age=60, sex="male", total_chol=6.0, sbp=150, smoker=1, region="high")

models.name: Globorisk
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk recalibrated to each country and calendar year
models.verification: Verified against the authors' R package.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import globorisk

globorisk(age=55, sex="male", sbp=140, smoker=1, country="MEX", year=2020,
          total_chol=5.5, diabetes=0)

models.name: WHO 2019
models.outcome: 10-year fatal and non-fatal CVD, laboratory and non-laboratory versions
models.verification: Verified against every cell of the official WHO charts and R WHORiskCalculator.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import who2019

who2019(age=55, sex="female", sbp=145, smoker=0, total_chol=6.0, diabetes=1,
        country="EGY")

models.name: PREVENT
models.fullName: AHA Predicting Risk of CVD EVENTs
models.outcome: 10- and 30-year total CVD, ASCVD, heart failure, CHD and stroke; base, UACR, HbA1c, SDI and full models
models.verification: Verified against the authors' worked examples and R preventr.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import prevent

prevent(age=50, sex="female", sbp=160, bp_treated=1, total_chol=5.2, hdl_chol=1.4,
        statin=0, diabetes=1, smoker=0, egfr=90, bmi=35, years=10, outcome="total_cvd")

models.name: Pooled Cohort Equations
models.outcome: 10-year hard ASCVD, ages 40-79, white and African American
models.verification: Verified against the guideline's Table A and R CVrisk / PooledCohort.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import pce

pce(age=55, sex="female", race="white", total_chol=5.5, hdl_chol=1.3, sbp=120,
    bp_treated=0, smoker=0, diabetes=0)

models.name: Framingham
models.outcome: 10-year general CVD, laboratory and BMI versions
models.verification: Verified against the Framingham Heart Study's own calculator spreadsheets, the paper's worked examples and R CVrisk.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import framingham

framingham(age=61, sex="female", sbp=124, bp_treated=0, smoker=1, diabetes=0,
           total_chol=4.65, hdl_chol=1.22)

models.name: Reynolds
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with hsCRP and parental history
models.verification: Implemented from the printed formulas (19/19 terms), checked against the papers' 17 worked examples.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import reynolds

reynolds(age=60, sex="female", sbp=135, total_chol=5.7, hdl_chol=1.3, hscrp=3.0,
         smoker=0, parental_history=1)

models.name: QRISK3
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with ethnicity, deprivation and clinical conditions
models.verification: Verified against ClinRisk's own C code and R QRISK3 (LGPL-3.0 module).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import qrisk3

qrisk3(age=64, sex="female", ethnicity="indian", smoking="non", bmi=27, chol_hdl_ratio=4.0,
       sbp=140, sbp_sd=8, townsend=0)

models.name: QRISK2
models.outcome: 10-year CVD risk with ethnicity, deprivation and clinical conditions
models.verification: Verified against ClinRisk's own C code, including its 30,000-patient validation (2.9e-13) (LGPL-3.0 module).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import qrisk2

qrisk2(age=64, sex="female", ethnicity="indian", smoking="non", bmi=27, chol_hdl_ratio=4.0, sbp=140)

models.name: FINRISK
models.outcome: 10-year CHD, stroke and CVD (CHD + stroke), ages 30-64
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's equations (4/4); Figure 1 reproduced (29/30 bars exact).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import finrisk

finrisk(age=50, sex="male", smoker=1, total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.3, sbp=140,
        diabetes=0, parent_mi=1, parent_stroke=0, outcome="cvd")

models.name: ADRS
models.outcome: 10-year ASCVD, hard CAD and stroke, ages 18+
models.verification: Implemented from Table 2 and the supplement's SPSS syntax (32/32 terms agree); no worked example exists.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import adrs

adrs(age=50, sex="male", smoker=1, sbp=135, dbp=85, tc_hdl=4.5, diabetes=0,
     hypertension=1, bp_treated=1, vitamin_d=25, egfr=95, outcome="ascvd")

models.name: PROCAM
models.outcome: 10-year acute coronary events in men 35-65 (points and risk table)
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's Tables 3-4 (30/30 bands checked at both ends).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import procam

procam(age=50, sex="male", ldl_chol=4.4, hdl_chol=1.0, triglycerides=2.0, sbp=140,
       smoker=1, diabetes=0, family_history=0)

models.name: REGICOR
models.outcome: 10-year coronary events, ages 35-74
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's Tables 1-2 (39/39 rows, 40/40 bands); worked-example slips documented.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import regicor

regicor(age=55, sex="male", total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.15, sbp=145, dbp=90,
        diabetes=0, smoker=1)

models.name: PREDICT
models.outcome: 5-year CVD (primary prevention, BMI, policy, type 2 diabetes), major bleeding, after CVD and after ACS
models.verification: Coefficients identical to the authors' R package; 49/49 printed table rows and both worked examples reproduced.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import predict_cvd

predict_cvd(age=55, sex="female", ethnicity="maori", nzdep=4, smoking="ex", diabetes=0,
            af=0, family_history=1, sbp=140, tc_hdl=4.5, bp_meds=1, lipid_meds=0,
            antithrombotic=0)

models.name: SMART-REACH
models.outcome: 10-year recurrent CVD risk and CVD-free life expectancy in established CVD
models.verification: Verified against the authors' calculator spreadsheet (600 patients, 3e-15).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import smart_reach

smart_reach(age=65, sex="male", smoker=0, diabetes=1, sbp=135, total_chol=4.5,
            creatinine=90, cad=1, cerebrovascular=0, pad=0)

models.name: LIFE-CVD2
models.outcome: Lifetime risk to 80, CVD-free life expectancy and treatment benefit
models.verification: Verified against the authors' 16 published charts (7,167/7,168 cells within printed precision).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import life_cvd2

life_cvd2(age=50, sex="female", smoker=1, sbp=150, total_chol=6.0, hdl_chol=1.4,
          region="moderate", outcome="lifetime_risk")

models.name: DIAL2
models.outcome: 10-year and lifetime CVD risk and CVD-free life expectancy in type 2 diabetes
models.verification: Checked against the paper's two worked examples (6/6 printed values).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import dial2

dial2(age=60, sex="male", smoker=0, sbp=140, total_chol=5.0, hdl_chol=1.1, hba1c=58,
      egfr=80, age_at_diagnosis=55, region="moderate", outcome="lifetime_risk")

models.name: CHA2DS2-VASc
models.outcome: Stroke risk points in atrial fibrillation (0-9)
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's point table; published rules checked.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import cha2ds2_vasc

cha2ds2_vasc(age=72, sex="female", heart_failure=0, hypertension=1, diabetes=0,
             stroke_tia_te=0, vascular_disease=0)

models.name: CHADS2
models.outcome: Stroke risk points in atrial fibrillation (0-6)
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's point table; Gage's worked example reproduced.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import chads2

chads2(age=76, heart_failure=1, hypertension=1, diabetes=0, stroke_tia=0)

models.name: HAS-BLED
models.outcome: Major bleeding risk points on anticoagulation (0-9)
models.verification: Implemented from the paper's point table; published rules checked.
models.example:
from cvd_risk import has_bled

has_bled(age=70, hypertension=1, abnormal_renal=0, abnormal_liver=0, stroke=0,
         bleeding=0, labile_inr=1, drugs=1, alcohol=0)

models.name: HEART
models.outcome: Major adverse cardiac events in chest pain (0-10)
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import heart

heart(history=1, ecg=1, age=58, risk_factors=2, atherosclerosis=0, troponin_ratio=0.5)

models.name: TIMI
models.outcome: 14-day adverse events in UA/NSTEMI (0-7)
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import timi

timi(age=68, risk_factors=3, coronary_stenosis=1, st_deviation=1, anginal_events_24h=2,
     aspirin_7d=1, elevated_markers=0)

models.name: EDACS
models.fullName: Emergency Department Assessment of Chest pain Score
models.outcome: Low-risk chest pain identification in the emergency department
models.verification: Verified against R RiskScorescvd (5,000 patients identical).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import edacs

edacs(age=52, sex="male", known_cad=0, risk_factors=2, diaphoresis=0,
      radiates_arm_shoulder=1, pleuritic=0, palpation=0)

models.name: GRACE
models.outcome: In-hospital (Granger 2003) and 6-month post-discharge (Eagle 2004) mortality points in ACS
models.verification: Implemented from the published nomograms (78/78 bands checked at both ends).
models.example:
from cvd_risk import grace_hospital

grace_hospital(killip=1, sbp=120, heart_rate=90, age=70, creatinine=1.2,
               cardiac_arrest=0, st_deviation=1, elevated_enzymes=1)
